name: monitor-not-rearmed
mistake: A monitor exited and was not restarted, leaving a running job unattended.
deterministic_aspects: A live registered job without a live monitor is reported at Stop.
judgement_aspects: A hook cannot choose useful resource thresholds, guarantee hourly scheduling, or restart a host task.

name: scan-live-output-directory
mistake: Listing or recursively scanning a job's output directory interfered with its running writer.
deterministic_aspects: Literal directory reads overlapping a registered live run directory are detected.
judgement_aspects: The hook cannot predict every filesystem or worker failure caused by concurrent readers.

name: session-directory-changed
mistake: Changing into a run directory changed the session working directory for later calls.
deterministic_aspects: A foreground bare directory change away from the project root is detected.
judgement_aspects: Path conventions beyond the documented literal shell grammar remain a workflow choice.

name: expanding-heredoc-wrote-script
mistake: Writing a script through an expanding heredoc changed its executable text.
reason: Outside section 11: the destination script extension alone is no longer a heredoc check; an unquoted heredoc without backticks does not block.
judgement_aspects: The source also required a dedicated write tool and a parse check; a generic hook cannot establish script correctness or require every quoted heredoc to use that tool.

name: review-premise-was-unmeasured
mistake: An incorrect resource measurement in a reviewer prompt produced an incorrect verdict.
reason: Not enforceable by a hook: deciding whether a premise accurately describes current measurements requires evidence and reviewer judgement.

name: wrong-process-targeted
mistake: Stopping a stalled job targeted a different worker process instead of the verified owned tree.
deterministic_aspects: The owned kill command rejects a changed creation identity.
judgement_aspects: A raw explicit PID kill can bypass the wrapper; determining the intended worker from arbitrary command lines is not enforceable by a hook.

name: launch-event-before-start-confirmation
mistake: A launched event was recorded before the command had successfully started.
deterministic_aspects: The launch command must not record a launched event when child creation fails, including a zero confirmation interval.
judgement_aspects: A started process is not proof that its scientific or operational result will be correct.

name: foreground-detached-monitor
mistake: Starting a monitor with a trailing background operator in a foreground tool call lost its notification path.
deterministic_aspects: A foreground shell call containing a statement-level background operator is detected.
judgement_aspects: Actual host notification delivery depends on the host's background-task support.

name: unmeasured-peak-resource-requirement
mistake: A job was admitted without measuring its full configuration's peak resource use.
reason: Not enforceable by a hook: defining representative inputs, measuring peak memory and deciding whether all execution options were covered require workload-specific evidence.

name: watchdog-missed-throughput-collapse
mistake: A watchdog noticed only complete stalls and missed a severe throughput reduction.
reason: Not enforceable by a hook: a useful throughput baseline and collapse threshold depend on the workload; heartbeat and duration checks do not establish throughput health.

name: discovery-identifier-collision
mistake: A discovery reused an identifier already written by another session.
deterministic_aspects: The post-write hook detects newly duplicated headings; next-id skips recorded identifiers.
judgement_aspects: Users can bypass reservations by manually editing records; choosing the right discovery content still requires judgement.

name: idle-resource-during-review-loop
mistake: Repeated build and review rounds left a scarce resource idle without an approved next job.
reason: Not enforceable by a hook: choosing a useful next experiment, balancing review quality against idle time and arranging a productive queue require scheduling judgement.

name: cleanup-used-unset-variable
mistake: A chained launcher attempted cleanup using an unset environment-derived path.
reason: Not enforceable by a hook: resolving environment values, branch conditions and the intended cleanup target generally requires executing or validating the script. A warning about a dynamic bound path cannot prove that this launcher bug was caught.

name: completion-only-waiter-missed-hang
mistake: A completion-only waiter left a hung job unattended far beyond a measured expected duration.
deterministic_aspects: The monitor command reports elapsed time above twice its configured expected duration.
judgement_aspects: Choosing the expected duration and recognizing changes to launch or import behaviour are not enforceable by a hook.

name: stopped-parent-left-children-running
mistake: Stopping a host task left queued child actions alive; disowned monitors also lost notifications.
deterministic_aspects: The explicit disown operation in the source countermeasure is detected.
judgement_aspects: This replay does not claim that a hook can clean up arbitrary children after a host task stop. Owned-tree termination belongs to ro kill; unregistered host tasks require process verification.

name: substantive-review-failure-overridden
mistake: A substantive independent review failure was overridden as harmless and the broken candidate was executed.
deterministic_aspects: The external command refuses an artifact whose latest independent receipt is FAIL, even after an earlier PASS.
judgement_aspects: The hook cannot decide whether a change is substantive, validate a review's reasoning, or stop someone from fabricating a replacement receipt.

name: shared-generator-changed-unregistered-behaviour
mistake: One builder generated several candidates and silently changed launch behaviour, imports and filenames beyond the registered change.
reason: Not enforceable by a hook: candidate boundaries and permissible semantic changes require a governing contract and a complete artifact comparison; generic shell syntax does not establish either.

name: submitted-name-differed-from-polled-identifier
mistake: A title included an owner-like prefix, so the created identifier differed from the identifier polled by the waiter.
reason: Not enforceable by a hook: title rules, returned identifiers and accessibility failures belong to the external service's response schema and its adapter, not generic shell classification.

name: live-script-rewritten-and-heredoc-expanded
mistake: A running shell script was rewritten, and an expanding heredoc executed backtick text intended for a record.
deterministic_aspects: Edits to a registered live script and backticks inside an unquoted heredoc are both detected.
judgement_aspects: Unregistered scripts and opaque interpreter strings remain outside this literal-path replay.

name: stale-budget-observation-used-in-planning
mistake: Planning reused an old resource-budget observation after the available budget had changed.
deterministic_aspects: The factual session brief explicitly marks a recorded observation older than its declared TTL as stale.
judgement_aspects: A hook cannot tell whether a later statement relies on that value or guarantee a fresh measurement immediately before every decision.

name: credential-scan-coverage-and-false-positive
mistake: A publication scanner lacked a pattern family; a later alert was investigated and found to be ordinary checksum text rather than a real credential.
deterministic_aspects: The authoritative outgoing-object scan detects a configured forbidden marker in an intermediate commit even after deletion; unrelated checksum text stays clean.
judgement_aspects: This test does not assert that the source incident exposed a credential. Deciding whether a matching value is a real secret and choosing complete service-specific patterns require investigation.

name: repeated-stray-background-and-directory-change
mistake: Foreground dispatch calls repeatedly appended a background loop, disown operation or session directory change.
deterministic_aspects: A statement-level background loop, disown and a bare directory change are detected independently.
judgement_aspects: Mapping an orphaned process back to its intended task before cleanup requires owned identity records or manual verification.

cases.name: background-loop-after-dispatch
cases.command: dispatch-a; until done-a; do sleep 1; done &

name: review-checklist-reconstructed-from-memory
mistake: Review checklists invented requirements or failed to name the exact governing file, producing false failures.
reason: Not enforceable by a hook: checking whether each review question faithfully quotes the applicable contract and names the correct evidence file requires semantic review.

name: required-multi-view-readout-omitted
mistake: Review prompts omitted a required multi-view readout, and a verdict ignored the combined decision and incomplete views.
deterministic_aspects: A configured literal required line missing from the corresponding agent brief is detected.
judgement_aspects: Presence of the line does not prove that all views were computed, eligibility was justified, or the final verdict interpreted the table correctly.

name: edit-dispatched-against-live-bound-files
mistake: An editor was dispatched against files bound by a newly launched job, invalidating later phases; a foreground directory change recurred.
deterministic_aspects: Writes and edits to registered live bound files and the repeated bare directory change are detected.
judgement_aspects: The hook cannot discover bindings omitted from the registry or guarantee that a newly versioned file preserves the intended behaviour.

name: cwd-recurrence-synthetic-fixtures-and-retry-policy
mistake: Bare directory changes recurred; a harness passed ordered synthetic fixtures but failed on real worker output; failed work also needed an explicit reviewed retry path.
deterministic_aspects: No current deterministic recall claim for this chain; protected literal operands are tested separately.
judgement_aspects: The hook cannot judge whether fixtures reproduce real output ordering, whether an admission replay is representative, or whether a workload-specific retry is reviewed. Those two source subparts are not claimed in recall.
reason: Only a bare trailing cd now receives shell.cd advice; this historical chained cd has no known protected operand and is quiet.

name: evidence-source-trust-and-post-result-reweighting
mistake: Claims treated one imperfect evidence source as ground truth or changed source weights after seeing results.
reason: Not enforceable by a hook: source error types, selection exposure, agreement and precommitted weighting require research judgement and an evidence ledger.

name: review-process-proportional-to-change
mistake: The workflow needed lighter combined reviews for admitted small changes, clerical fixes without repeated review, binding substantive failures and measured resource planning.
reason: Not enforceable by a hook: classifying clerical versus substantive changes, deciding review scope and choosing cost-effective execution resources require the governing agreement and judgement.
